output.title: Junior Manual QA Engineer (Mobile/Web)
output.description:
Introduction
We are looking for a Junior Manual QA Engineer to join our team for a high-impact mobile and web project. In this role, you will focus on testing our core iOS and Android mobile apps as well as web features, ensuring every new update meets our high quality standards before reaching users globally.
About Our Product
We are a product IT company behind a modern mobile app in the Fitness & Wellness niche. We empower users around the world to achieve their health and fitness goals easily and effectively. Through intuitive design, smart tracking, and engaging content, we help people build sustainable habits and live healthier lives.
Key Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
Mobile & Web Testing: Perform functional, regression, and smoke testing of our iOS and Android mobile applications.
Technical Analysis: Intercept and analyze traffic, test APIs, and inspect app logs to identify backend and client-side issues.
Documentation: Create, update, and maintain clear test documentation including checklists, test cases, and detailed bug reports.
Collaboration: Partner directly with developers and project managers to deliver high-quality updates faster.
Requirements
Must-Have Experience & Skills
6+ months of experience in manual testing of native mobile applications (iOS & Android).
Solid understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.
Hands-on experience with traffic proxies (Charles or Fiddler) and Postman for API testing.
Practical knowledge of obtaining and analyzing logs using Android Studio and Xcode.
Strong attention to detail, a proactive attitude, and the ability to hit the ground running quickly.
Nice-to-Have
Experience in web application testing.
Offer & Conditions
Work Format
100% Remote (Full-time engagement)
Compensation
Up to $700 / month
Target Start Date
October 19–22, 2026
Hiring Process
Combined Technical & Cultural Interview
Offer

drafts.cover_letter:
Hello!

I'm Iryna, a Manual QA Engineer with 1.5 years of commercial experience in mobile testing, and your Manual QA Engineer (Mobile) role at United Tech caught my attention. I know the posting asks for 3+ years, so I'd rather be upfront about my level.

At Brightleaf Apps I test iOS and Android apps and a web admin panel. I run functional, smoke, regression and release testing on a 2-week release cycle. I maintain about 300 test cases and checklists in TestRail, report bugs in Jira, test REST APIs in Postman and inspect client-server traffic with Charles Proxy. I read logs in Android Studio and Xcode, and I rebuilt our regression checklist so a full run takes 1 day instead of 2. I also have basic SQL and work in Scrum.

I haven't worked with MongoDB yet, but I'm keen to learn it and to take on A/B experiment testing in a larger product team. I can start within a week. I'd be glad to talk if my experience could fit the team.

Best regards,
Iryna Bondar
